description: Wait until something new arrives for you in the Assistant Inbox app on this phone: a message or a task. Returns when a message or task you have not been told about yet is waiting (at once if one already is), and `nothing yet` after timeout_ms (up to 25000, default 25000) when not. structuredContent.pending lists the new message ids and task ids. When it returns an event, read it with check_inbox or my_tasks, then call wait_for_event again to listen for the next one: items already returned do not wake you again.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait, in ms (default 25000)

name: wait_for_event
